notes.title: Demo 0.0.1 hotfixes
notes.content:
Alt+Enter now switches between windowed mode and fullscreen mode.

Alt+F4 now closes the game.

Trees in Dark Forest now sometimes drop Grass.

Trees in Dark Forest now sometimes drop... Food, sort of!

Dark Forest now sometimes spawn white mushrooms.

Animals now spawn in Dark Forest biome.



(FIX) Broken save files should be skipped now from loading instead of crashing the game.

(FIX) Remove assertion message box that allowed to continue executing the game. Which could've caused a lot of bad things!

(FIX) Made hoes flavor text more useful.

(FIX) Slingshot mechanics converted to bow mechanics for now.

(FIX) Bow mechanics now require you to charge the shot.

(FIX) Spear mechanics now require you to charge the attack. Still no good animation tho!

(FIX) Attacking with a spear now locks your movement.

(FIX) Save files now show their version if they are outdated. Auto-conversion will occur on loading, so everything should be fine.

(FIX) Fix playtime calculation for save files. Which reset playtimes on all the save files, o7

(FIX) Cartography technologies now have small descriptions.

(FIX) You can now cook Raw Chicken in the Furnace.

(FIX) You can't build on top of the player anymore. Hopefully.

(FIX) Fixed icon size for belts.

(FIX) Player now starves until reaching 1hp, no more exploding at 0 hp when trying to mine some material. Which was fun!
